title: Composition counit square at one affine spectrum complex
statement: Let $X,X\prime$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $g:X\prime\to X$. Choose the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] and the pinned derived counits $\epsilon_f$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. For an arbitrary cochain complex $P$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules set $j=X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $j\prime=X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}(g_{\mathrm{top}})$ and $a=T(s,j)^{-1}T(j\prime,g,sj)$, where $T$ is the pinned underived composition isomorphism [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso] and the second comparison uses inverse-spectrum naturality. If $\alpha:L_s\circ L_j\simeq L_{j\prime}\circ L_g$ is the pinned affine-spectrum derived comparison [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates], then $L_s(\epsilon_{j,P})\,\epsilon_{s,j^*P}\,Q(a_P)=\alpha_{Q(P)}\,L_{j\prime}(\epsilon_{g,P})\,\epsilon_{j\prime,g^*P}$. No K-flatness, coefficient morphism, or representative isomorphism is assumed.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-pullback-composition (Tag 0D5S); counit factorization of the selected composition comparison

proof.text: Use the composition family selected by exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Its recorded leftDerivedLift equation and Mathlib Functor.leftDerived_fac give the natural-transformation factorization; evaluate this at the homotopy image of P. The inverse underived mate is the inverse of tensorPullbackCompositionIso: unfold its definition and use pushforwardCongr rfl = Iso.refl. The quotient comparison maps this termwise comparison definitionally to DerivedCategory.Q of the same comparison. Normalize functor composition on objects and reassociate to obtain composition_factorization, with no assumption on P.

Transport composition_factorization along an equality of composite scheme maps by equality induction. Apply it to (Spec.map g.appTop, X.isoSpec.inv) and to (Xprime.isoSpec.inv,g), using isoSpec_inv_naturality for the second path. The elementary compare_counit_factorizations identity cancels the derived and underived composition isomorphisms, never a counit. Termwise mapping preserves the composite of the inverse first underived comparison and the second one. The elementary inverse-transport identity and the inverse-composite law identify the resulting derived comparison with affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso, proving the displayed square.
